messages:
customer_acme: Hey, we're getting 422 from the API when using response_format=json with strict=true. Started after we rolled a parser change this morning. ccing @eva_support

eta_support: Sorry about the trouble — can you paste the exact curl you used (headers + body)?

customer_acme: Here's the curl we use:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"...","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
```

customer_acme: Response we get:

```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/problem+json

{"error":"response_validation_failed","details":"expected Content-Type 'application/json' when strict mode enabled"}
```

matt_eng: Thanks — reproducing locally now. Looks like the JSON-mode middleware is doing an exact equality check on Content-Type and rejecting any charset variants. That's a bug.

arjun_sre: Confirmed. Test added that only checks startswith 'application/json' but current prod code uses === 'application/json'. I'll prepare a minimal fix to accept charset suffixes and also add a defensive parse fallback.

matt_eng: I'll open a hotfix PR that relaxes header check and adds unit tests + an end-to-end for strict=true + charset. Also adding a regression test for Accept header variants.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #542 (jsonmode-contenttype-relax) to staging

matt_eng: Deployed to staging — @customer_acme can you re-run the same curl (no changes on your side) to verify?

customer_acme: Re-ran against staging, same curl, same headers. Works now — 200 and valid JSON returned. :tada:

eva_support: We'll promote the fix to prod in ~30m and post back here. Also updating docs to clarify header acceptance and adding example with charset. Thanks for the repro snippet!

sophie_prod: Patch rolled out to production. Monitoring shows the 422 spikes cleared and no regressions in other routes.

customer_acme: Confirmed production is working for our traffic. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Closing our escalated ticket. :thumbsup:

matt_eng: Root cause: strict JSON enforcement compared exact Content-Type header. Fix: accept 'application/json' plus optional parameters (e.g., charset) and add fallback parse path that attempts to parse text bodies labelled as JSON. Postmortem + PR link to be added to the ticket.

arjun_sre: Followups: (1) update SDK examples to include charset in Content-Type where applicable, (2) add e2e test matrix for common header variations, (3) ship docs change. Will track as ACTION-1244.
